visual_direction.differentiation_from_home: While the Home page uses warm bone hero transitioning into near-black (#070708) with warm gold (#C2A059) accents, the Opulence page uses a dramatic botanical midnight aesthetic: deep dark emerald background tinting (#061410 & #070708), subtle emerald-glow micro-accents (#1DB98B / #0C3B2E), brushed platinum highlights (#D8D8DC), and high-contrast sales floating triggers. It evokes high-end architectural botanical sanctuaries.

specifications_accordion.details: Earthquake resistant RCC framed structure built with M25/M30 grade concrete as per IS code standards.
3-Phase concealed copper wiring (Finolex/Havells) with modular switches (Schneider/Legrand). 100% DG power backup.
Premium CP fittings (Kohler/Grohe) and sanitary ware (Duravit/Roca). Anti-skid vitrified tiles with glass shower partitions.
High-speed automatic passenger & service elevators (Otis/Schindler) with ARD emergency landing and luxury cab interiors.
8 ft high teak wood main door frame with veneered shutter. Heavy-duty powder-coated UPVC/aluminum sliding acoustic windows.
Imported Italian marble in living, dining & foyer. Engineered wooden flooring in master suite. Vitrified tiles in other bedrooms.
Internal walls finished with royal acrylic emulsion over smooth POP punning. Weatherproof exterior texture paint.
Modular kitchen ready provision with granite counter, stainless steel double sink, chimney outlet & dedicated water purifier point.
24x7 treated water supply through central RO plant, rainwater harvesting reservoirs & dual plumbing system.
High-speed Wi-Fi corridors, automated boom barriers, biometric lobby entry, EV charging stations & solar lighting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Register route '/opulence' in /app/frontend/src/App.js with Suspense fallback
Add 'Opulence' link to Nav (/app/frontend/src/components/Nav.jsx) with a golden 'Flagship' badge
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, accordions, and cards have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='opulence-hero-enquire-btn', data-testid='opulence-spec-accordion-structure')
Use Framer Motion for section entrances and Lenis for smooth scroll
Ensure total dark mode compatibility with emerald-tinted accents and high contrast readable text

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: MANDATORY: Every button, link, accordion header, tab, input, and floating trigger MUST have a kebab-case data-testid.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_states: All buttons must have explicit text and background colors on hover. Never leave text color implicit.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high APCA contrast. Headings in gold (#C2A059) or platinum (#D8D8DC) over dark ink (#070708 / #061410).
